about: How people say how long ago they last saw someone, in passing: never a calendar date (owner, Oct 15, evening: nobody says a date in speech, 'I talked to Diana on November 13'). The first row whose upToDays covers the gap is said. Authored, calibrated to the way Americans mention a recent contact in the conversation bank; the engine only picks the row by the contact record's date.
author: Words line, Claude Sonnet 5.5
